'''Wyss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Slavery/Legends|servant]] of the [[Hidden Ones]] in [[43 ABY]]. He was serving under [[the Hidden One]] formerly known as [[Koro Ziil]] when former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] freed the Hidden Ones from [[Caverns of the Hidden One|their caverns]] after a [[Confrontation in the Caverns of the Hidden One|duel]] of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|powers]] between Luke and Ziil.<ref name="FOTJ: Outcast" />
